item.title: Illinois bobcat season ends with 627 harvested, state officials say
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Ill., (KBSI) — The 2025–2026 Illinois bobcat hunting and trapping season ended Feb. 15 with 627 bobcats harvested, according to the Illinois Department of Natural Resources. Officials said 405 bobcats (62%) were harvested by hunters, while 222 (34%) were taken by trappers. Another 27 bobcats (4%) were salvaged by permit holders in cases such as roadkill. item.description: JACKSON, Mo., (KBSI) — Jackson Fire Rescue says temporary shower and laundry services that were available to the public have been discontinued.
